module tools.cursor_transition_census
import tools.cursor_transition_proof { CurrentCount, advance_current }
import v2.compiler.tokenize { lex_walk_init }
import v2.extdeps.languages.dag { dag_lex_rules }
import v2.std.algebra { length }
import extdeps.filesystem.filesystem_io { Filesystem }
import std.process { ProcessExit, ExitSuccess, exit_failure }
fn main(input_path: String, receipt_path: String) -> ProcessExit {
 let read = Filesystem.Read(path: input_path)
 if !read.success { exit_failure(reason: "input unreadable") } else {
 let source = chars(s: read.content)
 let end = advance_current(seed: CurrentCount { state: lex_walk_init(src: source, file: ^comparison, rules: dag_lex_rules()), steps: 0 }, source: source, count: length(xs: source))
 if end.state.done && !end.state.error && end.state.remaining.index == length(xs: source) {
 let written = Filesystem.Write(path: receipt_path, content: "{end.steps} {length(xs: end.state.tokens)} {end.state.remaining.index}")
 if written.success { ExitSuccess } else { exit_failure(reason: "census write failed") }
 } else { exit_failure(reason: "census did not reach EOF") }
 }
}
